machines.name: HOIST ROC-IT Chest Press
machines.cues: Elbows flared, keep it controlled

machines.name: Nautilus Leverage Chest Press
machines.cues: Elbows flared, sit upright with back against the pad, handles start beside the chest, press forward

machines.name: Hammer Strength Select Chest Press
machines.cues: Elbows ~30-45° from torso (not fully flared), chest up, back supported by the pad
machines.caution: Don't force excessive depth if the shoulder starts to pinch

machines.name: Nautilus Selectorized Chest Press (Lakeway)
machines.cues: Elbows flared

machines.name: Selectorized Chest Press (San Jose)
machines.cues: Elbows flared

machines.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Bench Press
machines.cues: Elbows ~30-45° from torso (not fully flared), chest up, back supported by the pad
machines.caution: Don't force excessive depth if the shoulder starts to pinch

machines.name: Hammer Strength Select Incline Press
machines.cues: Elbows tucked ~30-45° (not flared), handles start around armpit/upper chest, controlled range of motion
machines.caution: Don't force the bottom position if the right shoulder feels pinchy

machines.name: Incline Press (Mauricio)
machines.cues: Elbows tucked, don't flare the elbows, controlled range for the shoulder

machines.name: Incline Press (San Jose)
machines.cues: Elbows tucked, don't flare the elbows

machines.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Incline Press
machines.cues: Elbows tucked ~30-45° (not flared), handles start around armpit/upper chest, controlled range of motion
machines.caution: Don't force the bottom position if the right shoulder feels pinchy

machines.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Decline Press
machines.cues: Elbows ~30-45° from torso, controlled range of motion
machines.caution: Don't force excessive depth if the shoulder starts to pinch

machines.name: Pec-Deck / Chest Fly
machines.cues: Face away from the pad, bring arms forward and together (opposite of rear-delt use)

machines.name: Nautilus Impact Deltoid Fly / Pec Fly
Cable Tower (single-arm pulldown)
machines.cues: Single handle, pulley ~mid-shoulder height, palm down, elbow tucked beside body, upper arm fixed (only forearm moves), extend until nearly straight, don't swing the shoulder

machines.name: HOIST Seated Dip
machines.cues: Narrow grip, elbows tucked, brace abs, full movement (don't shorten the bottom)

machines.name: Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Shoulder Press
machines.cues: Elbows tucked/aligned (not flared), handles start at shoulder/upper-chest level (not near nipples), forearms ~vertical, controlled return, don't let elbows travel far behind the torso

machines.name: Nautilus Shoulder Press (San Jose)
machines.cues: Elbows tucked, press smoothly, don't force a deep bottom stretch

machines.name: Nautilus Impact Deltoid Raise
machines.cues: "Scooch the booch", "flat-table it" (flatten arms as you raise)

machines.name: HOIST Lat Pulldown
machines.cues: Wide grip, elbows follow the machine's arc, drive elbows down, pull to upper chest, pull from armpits/elbows (not hands), pause/squeeze at bottom

machines.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown (Mauricio/Winchester)
machines.cues: Wide grip, drive elbows down, pull to upper chest

machines.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Front Lat Pulldown
machines.cues: Independent levers, drive elbows down

machines.name: Cable Tower
machines.cues: Elbows tucked

machines.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Low Row
machines.cues: Independent levers, elbows tucked

machines.name: Iso-Lateral Upper-Back Row
machines.cues: Elbows flared for upper back, one arm at a time, lean forward so chest is firmly on the pad, don't count the set if you sit back and lose chest support · Confirm this is the Upper-Back Row machine

machines.name: Iso-Lateral High Row
machines.cues: Chest planted on the support, shoulders down, drive elbows fully back, controlled

machines.name: Star Trac Rear-Delt Fly (Reverse Pec-Deck)
machines.cues: Face into the machine, arms move outward/back, pull elbows fully back (reverse of chest fly)

machines.name: Nautilus Impact Deltoid Fly / Pec Fly

biceps-curl.name: Biceps Curl

machines.name: Incline Bench + Dumbbells
machines.cues: Bench on 4th hole, back & shoulders supported, arms nearly straight at bottom, elbows behind/under shoulders, upper arm still, alternate arms, rotate dumbbell (parallel at bottom → perpendicular at top), wrist neutral (don't fold), don't rock torso or bring elbow forward

biceps-curl.pinned: Avoid Nautilus Impact Biceps Curl, hurt shoulder

machines.name: Nautilus Hack Squat (Lakeway)
machines.cues: Feet apart & centered, toes at the upper horizontal line, heels over the notched part of the platform, machine Level 3, back & hips supported, brace abs, don't turn toes far out, don't lock knees at top

machines.name: Plate-Loaded Hack Squat (San Jose)
machines.cues: Don't turn toes too far out, don't lock knees at top

machines.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Extension
machines.cues: Independent levers, one leg at a time

machines.name: Nautilus Inspiration Leg Extension
machines.cues: Backup when the Hammer Strength is busy

machines.name: Nautilus Inspiration Seated Leg Curl
machines.cues: Feet neutral or slightly toes-up, don't rotate or point the feet, knees track straight ahead

machines.name: HOIST Adductor (Inner Thigh)
machines.cues: Comfortable starting width (next-wider was too wide), squeeze inward, open again under control · brand of the 8-5 / 8-6 twins unconfirmed

machines.name: Adductor (other gym)
machines.cues: Movement is inward

machines.name: HOIST Abductor (Outer Thigh)
machines.cues: Push outward, start smoothly and gradually, don't pop/launch the pads, controlled return · brand of the 8-5 / 8-6 twins unconfirmed

machines.name: Abductor (other gym)
machines.cues: Movement is outward

machines.name: Nautilus Standing Calf Raise
machines.caution: Reported a significant pull under the inside of the right heel after using this machine
